title: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract: Late Charge on an Installment Whose Payment Posted After Its Grace Period
content:
**Servicing Policy Manual and desk system reference — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

## Scope

This policy figures the late charge owed on an installment whose payment posted after its grace period had ended, including a payment received after the cutoff on the last grace day that posted the next business day, where no late charge was booked for that installment.

For a late charge on an installment that no payment reached within its grace period, that a payment posted after the grace period has since satisfied and that no returned payment re-opened, and only for such a late charge, the charge is the late-posted installment late charge figured on the installment as it stood when the grace period ended, still capped at the lower of the product's company maximum late charge and the contract's recorded state maximum late charge; a late charge on an installment left unpaid past its grace period and a late charge on an installment re-opened by a returned payment follow the company's own schedules for those two cases, and any other late charge is the product's late-charge percentage of the unpaid installment portion, capped at the lower of the company maximum late charge and the contract's recorded state maximum late charge, and is not figured under this policy.

## Conditions

The grace period, the status the contract must be in and the limit of one late charge per installment due date apply exactly as the company's late charge rule for this product states them.

For an installment whose payment posted after its grace period had ended and that no returned payment re-opened, and only for such an installment, the unpaid portion compared with the product's minimum unpaid amount for a late charge is the portion that stood when the grace period ended, so a late charge is assessed when that portion is at least the minimum even though a later payment has since satisfied the installment, and none is assessed on such an installment that an extension deferred; for every other installment, including one left unpaid past its grace period and one re-opened by a returned payment, no late charge is assessed when the unpaid portion as of the assessment date is less than the minimum unpaid amount for a late charge, on an installment deferred by an extension, or on an installment that was paid in full within the grace period.

| Installment | Portion compared with the minimum | Deferred by an extension |
|---|---|---|
| Payment posted after the grace period, never re-opened by a return | the portion that stood when the grace period ended | no late charge |
| Any other installment | the unpaid portion as of the assessment date | no late charge |

## Booking the charge

The charge is booked with the agent-side tool `assess_late_posted_installment_late_charge_04190f4f`. It is a hidden tool: the agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**What one call does.** It books one late charge, dated today, against the named installment due date of the contract and adds it to the fees due on the contract; the customer can see the charge and the new fees-due balance on the account.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `retail_contract_id` | the reference number of the retail installment contract the late charge is assessed on, as returned by the retail contract lookup (`find_retail_contracts`) |
| `installment_due_date` | the due date of the installment the late charge relates to, written YYYY-MM-DD as a calendar date with no time zone; never empty |
| `late_charge_amount` | the late charge assessed, in USD with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the late charge reference (an opaque text identifier), the contract reference, the installment due date (YYYY-MM-DD), the late charge in USD with 2 decimal places and the new fees-due balance in USD with 2 decimal places. A sentence that starts with "Late charge assessed" means the charge is on the contract.
